def run_rows(rows, label='motion', cameras=()):
    global res, call_idx
    rows=np.asarray(rows)
    for start in range(0,len(rows),180):
        chunk=rows[start:start+180]
        before=r.status()
        try:
            res=r.submit('ee_pose',chunk,dt=.05,video='none',cameras=list(cameras),note=label)
        except Exception:
            after=r.wait_ready();print('RESUME',before,after,flush=True)
            if after['calls']==before['calls']:
                res=r.submit('ee_pose',chunk,dt=.05,video='none',cameras=list(cameras),note=label)
            else:
                res=r.get_obs(cameras=list(cameras))
        call_idx+=1

        failures=sum(p.get('ik_failures',0) for p in res.meta.get('plan',[]))

def move_to(p, speed=.12, dwell=.15, rows=None):
    global last_target
    own=rows is None
    if own: rows=[]
    p=np.array(p,float)
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(p-last_target)/(speed*.05))))
    for t in np.linspace(0,1,n+1)[1:]:rows.append([*(last_target+(p-last_target)*t),*quat])
    for i in range(round(dwell/.05)):rows.append([*p,*quat])
    last_target=p
    if own:run_rows(rows)
    return rows

    move_to(well,speed=.06,dwell=.4,rows=rows)
    move_to([*well[:2],.075],rows=rows)
    if own:run_rows(rows,'dip '+str(color))
    return rows

def park():

    move_to([-.30,0,.16],rows=rows)

import json,numpy as np

def rgb_lab(rgb):
